blocks.text: Uptown Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Uptown is the Sixth Street and Sixth Avenue plateau neighbourhood in New Westminster, designated a Frequent Transit Development Area in the City's Official Community Plan (OCP), "Our City 2041," Bylaw No. 7925, 2017.
City Hall, at 511 Royal Avenue, sits at the area's south edge, and the New Westminster Public Library's main branch is at 716 Sixth Avenue.
Moody Park lies at the neighbourhood's north-west edge, and the Queen's Park Heritage Conservation Area, the city's one conservation area, lies just east of Uptown.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: the housing stock

items.t: The stock is detached houses on the plateau streets under the RS districts of Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001: the RS-1 district requires a minimum site area of 557.40 square metres (6,000 square feet) with a floor space ratio of 0.5.
RS districts allow secondary suites, and laneway and carriage houses are regulated under the same bylaw, so the house stock carries suite and laneway potential by zone rather than by exception.
New Westminster Secondary School, at 820 Sixth Street, is the city's single secondary school and the plateau's largest institution.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Uptown's Frequent Transit Development Area designation in Our City 2041 is the plan frame for added density around the Sixth Street corridor.

The Queen's Park Heritage Conservation Area is the city's one conservation area and sits just east of Uptown, so heritage conservation rules apply across the east edge rather than inside Uptown itself.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Royal City Centre, at 610 Sixth Street, is the plateau's mall, with 40 or more shops, per the mall's own site.

The replacement New Westminster Secondary School opened January 11, 2021 and was already above capacity per the district's long-range facilities plan, so school capacity is a live issue in this catchment.
École Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary, in the recorded chain for 1714 Eighth Avenue, is where Early French Immersion is offered on this side of the city.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The speculation and vacancy tax applies in New Westminster, so owners declare annually.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: getting around

items.t: Sixth Street and Sixth Avenue are the plateau's corridors, carrying the 105, 106, 103 and 123 buses, and the Expo Line stations at New Westminster and Columbia sit below the plateau to the south-east.
City Hall at 511 Royal Avenue anchors the south edge, so civic business is at the neighbourhood's edge rather than across the city.

blocks.text: Uptown Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the lot's RS district figures before planning: RS-1 requires a minimum site of 557.40 square metres at a floor space ratio of 0.5 under Zoning Bylaw No. 6680, 2001.
Confirm whether a lot on the east edge falls inside the Queen's Park Heritage Conservation Area, the city's one conservation area, since the boundary runs just east of Uptown.

blocks.text: Uptown home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

10 houses sold in Uptown with a median price of $1,312,500 (the middle half sold between $1,143,750 and $1,537,500), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 98.2% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $601 per square foot, a median year built of 1927 and a median lot of 4,458 square feet.

blocks.text: Jared's take on Uptown

Uptown is New West’s plateau neighbourhood, with houses around the Sixth Street shops and Royal City Centre, and the 2024 təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre as its civic anchor. People like the scale and accept that there’s no SkyTrain station on the plateau itself.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Uptown?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 14 houses listed in Uptown. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Uptown a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Uptown had a sales ratio of 7%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Uptown from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 3 houses sold in Uptown over those 5 months, out of 75 in all of New Westminster.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Uptown?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

School District No. 40 (SD40) runs a single secondary school, New Westminster Secondary at 820 Sixth Street, whose replacement school opened January 11, 2021 at a cost of 106.5 million dollars with 1,900 seats; recorded locator chains include Lord Kelvin Elementary, Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary for 835 Eighth Street, and École Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary, Fraser River Middle and New Westminster Secondary for 1714 Eighth Avenue.

faq.q: Is there a SkyTrain station in Uptown?
faq.a: No: the nearest stations are New Westminster and Columbia, on the Expo Line below the plateau, and Uptown is served by buses including the 105 (Uptown and New Westminster Station), the 106 (Edmonds and New Westminster Station), the 103 and the 123 on the Sixth Street and Sixth Avenue corridors.

faq.q: What can I visit without leaving the neighbourhood?
faq.a: The təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre, at 65 East Sixth Avenue, fully opened in May 2024 at 10,644 square metres, and its name is the hən̓q̓əmin̓əm̓ word for "sea otter house"; Moody Park, with its pool and spray park, and Moody Park Arena at 701 Eighth Avenue are at the north-west edge.

faq.q: What did houses in Uptown sell for?
faq.a: 10 houses sold in Uptown between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,312,500.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Uptown?
faq.a: The median was 16 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.2% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
